# Prashant Chataut

Prashant builds apps and writes from Nepal.

## Projects
- [NEBians](https://nebians.consica.com.np/): Study resources and conversations for students and teachers.
- [Kairos](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Kairos): Words, thoughts, affirmations, and letters to a future self.
- [Retra](https://github.com/prashantchataut/Retra): An Android Game Boy Advance emulator with its own engine, patcher, and original game.

## Writing
- [Grace](https://knowprashant.vercel.app/writes/grace): A poem.
- [Where the first idea led](https://knowprashant.vercel.app/writes/where-the-first-idea-led): The story of the projects.
